*C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris, Ser. I*

3 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** Van der Put and Reversat described the form of a pure q-difference module with non integral slopes. We deduce from this explicit matricial descriptions of the isoformal analytic classes and of the Galois group of pureq-difference modules with non integral slopes. © 2011 Académie des sciences.
